verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's own JavaScript scenario feature can click and fill fields before returning HTML, so a form or login wall could be scripted, and premium proxies are documented to bypass difficult sites. CAPTCHA solving and a dedicated login or form-wall workflow are not documented, so only part of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: documented CAPTCHA solving, a documented automated login or authentication flow, evidence of agent-driven wall handling without hand-written scenarios, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent automatically get past a CAPTCHA, login, or form wall without my manual intervention

citations.quote: If you want to interact with pages you want to scrape before we return your the HTML you can add JavaScript scenario to your API call.
Use premium proxies to bypass difficult to scrape websites
Pass custom cookies to the webpage you want to scrape
